title: Advice to young musicians and goodbye
summary: Lead a clean life and stay away from drink; the interview closes.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Well, I think we have just about everything we need, unless there's something else you'd like to add that you can think of, either about your life or your trombone style or playing.
For kids who want to take up instruments, lead a clean life. Get a lot of rest. And be good and polite to people. And you'll always get by. Stay away from the lush. That's all I can tell.
Okay, well, thanks very much, George. We certainly appreciate your advice and all your time in this story.
Of course, I don't practice what I preach, but for newcomers, it's a good idea.
